{{Top|leg}}
The '''Battle of [[Sintheti]]''' was a military engagement in [[402 BBY/Legends|402 BBY]] notable for the hiring of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and [[Sun Guard]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] groups by opposing sides.

==History==
The battle continued the age-old feud between the two warrior groups and began due to a squabble over the [[Horned Throne]] on the planet, with rival claimants to the throne hiring the respective mercenary groups. The majority of fighting took place within the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] catacombs and crags. The conflict lasted for over three years, from [[402 BBY/Legends|402 BBY]] to late [[399 BBY/Legends|399 BBY]], or early [[398 BBY]].
